findings.motion: HB 1265 (various elections matters), House third reading, Roll Call 90 (94 yeas, 0 nays). She is in the yea list. She was also in the yea list for the House vote adopting Conference Committee Report 1 on 2024-03-07, Roll Call 322 (94-0).
findings.note: General election-law bill (became Public Law 153). The enrolled text includes updating a voter's registration record with the voter identification number from poll lists and affidavits, and a rule that only US citizens may be in the polls. It is not mainly a voter ID or citizenship bill. Saved as a related election-law vote.
